scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none text-stone-900 font-medium

visual_enhancers.surface: Flat Solid. No Glassmorphism for clinical apps. Warm solid backgrounds (e.g., white or stone-50) with 1px subtle borders (border-stone-200).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use shadow-sm for subtle lifts on hover.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-lg (8px) for cards and inputs.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside containers to allow breathing room despite high data density.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content, tables, and forms.

component_path.general: Use Shadcn components in JS. Override default border colors to stone-200 and primary colors to custom Sage.
component_path.cards: Flat solid cards, e.g., bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-lg p-6
component_path.navigation: Sidebar layout for desktop, hamburger for mobile. Sidebar should have distinct background (#F2EFE9).

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions for feedback. Fast, crisp transitions.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-ins for dashboard widgets (opacity 0 to 1, y 10 to 0).

accessibility.contrast: Text on primary color must be white. Ensure WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='patient-table-row').

image_urls.description: Warm medical clinic waiting room, used for login page split-screen background
Warm portrait of a medical staff member, used for user profile avatar placeholder
Close up of maternity/pregnancy care, used for empty states in patient records or maternity section

3d_libraries: Not applicable for this context (data-heavy clinical dashboard). Stick to 2D Shadcn charts (Recharts) for dashboard statistics.
instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Use the primary Sage color (#5B7C62) for primary actions.
Implement a clean, sidebar-based dashboard layout. Sidebar should be #F2EFE9 and main content #F9F8F6.
All components must be written in Javascript (.jsx/.js), not Typescript.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for all UI icons.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and major layout elements.
Implement forms and tables for Data Pasien, Rekam Medis, Obat/Resep, Kunjungan, and Tagihan exactly as specified, using Rupiah (Rp) for currency formatting.
Use Shadcn calendar for Antenatal Care (ANC) scheduling.
Ensure the application language is entirely Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) as requested.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or similar js path.
